t: Time 3183Y black flexible cable delivers dependable performance for washing machines and extension leads. This 10m coil features a robust 3-core design with brown, blue and green/yellow copper conductors rated 300/500V. The substantial 1.5mm² conductor area safely manages the current demands of major appliances and multi-device extensions, whilst the PVC sheath maintains reliability between -15°C and 70°C. With 48 strands per core, the cable provides exceptional flexibility for secure connections and discreet routing in domestic and commercial environments.
